calls.statement:
WITH lines AS (
  SELECT f.member_key, f.sale_date, f.receipt_id, f.channel_code, s.store_id, p.category, w.status
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND s.store_id = 900
  WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2025-12-21' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2025-12-21' AND f.member_key IS NOT NULL
),
base AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM lines l JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = l.member_key),
clean AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM lines l JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = l.member_key
          WHERE l.store_id <> 999 AND l.category <> 'ZZ Test'),
clean2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM lines l JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = l.member_key
          WHERE l.store_id <> 999 AND l.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND COALESCE(l.status,'x') <> 'cancelled')
SELECT cur.tier,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM base b JOIN dim_member c ON c.member_id=b.member_id AND DATE '2025-12-21' BETWEEN c.valid_from AND c.valid_to WHERE c.tier=cur.tier) AS base_n,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM clean b JOIN dim_member c ON c.member_id=b.member_id AND DATE '2025-12-21' BETWEEN c.valid_from AND c.valid_to WHERE c.tier=cur.tier) AS clean_n,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM clean2 b JOIN dim_member c ON c.member_id=b.member_id AND DATE '2025-12-21' BETWEEN c.valid_from AND c.valid_to WHERE c.tier=cur.tier) AS clean2_n
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tier FROM dim_member) cur ORDER BY 1

WITH act AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2025-12-21' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2025-12-21'
),
v AS (
  SELECT a.member_id, count(c.member_key) AS versions_on_date, min(c.tier) AS t1, max(c.tier) AS t2, min(c.join_date) AS jd
  FROM act a LEFT JOIN dim_member c ON c.member_id=a.member_id AND DATE '2025-12-21' BETWEEN c.valid_from AND c.valid_to
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT versions_on_date, count(*) AS members, sum(CASE WHEN t1<>t2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS conflicting_tier, sum(CASE WHEN jd > DATE '2025-12-21' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS joined_after
FROM v GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT min(sale_date) AS mn, max(sale_date) AS mx, count(DISTINCT sale_date) AS days,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date > DATE '2025-12-21'-364 AND calendar_date <= DATE '2025-12-21' AND is_trading_day) AS trading_days,
  count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys,
  (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT coalesce(tier,'NULL'), ',') FROM dim_member) AS tiers
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date > DATE '2025-12-21'-364 AND sale_date <= DATE '2025-12-21'

calls.statement:
WITH active AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2025-12-21' - 364
      AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2025-12-21'
)
SELECT cur.tier, COUNT(*) AS active_members
FROM active a
JOIN dim_member cur ON cur.member_id = a.member_id
                   AND DATE '2025-12-21' BETWEEN cur.valid_from AND cur.valid_to
GROUP BY cur.tier
ORDER BY CASE cur.tier WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1 WHEN 'Silver' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
